summary.text: Ken Jamison is a Democratic state representative who has represented Missouri House District 15 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Jamison is a Marine Corps veteran and attorney.

paragraphs.text: Kenneth Jamison served in the U.S. Marine Corps for four years and graduated from Oak Park High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Missouri in 2008 and a law degree there in 2016.
His career experience includes working as an attorney.
Jamison took office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Maggie Nurrenbern.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Children and Families and Judiciary committees.
He is listed as the only candidate in the 2026 general election for the seat.
